text:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — P0: Canary failure for release r-2026-03-15 in us-west-2 canary cluster. 5xx rate on /v1/generate increased from 0.4% -> 12% starting 03:12 UTC. Alert rules: error-rate>5% for 2m. Pager: @raj oncall.

raj: I’m on it. Looking at canary pods now. First glance = spike correlating with canary replica autoscaler activity.

marta: I see the metrics too — tail latency also jumped. Can you paste the canary revision id?

raj: canary revision = r-2026-03-15-c3. Checking logs.

raj: logs show repeated OOM kills on inference-worker containers, then retries, then 502s from gateway. Example: 
```
OOMKilled: process killed after allocation failed in attention kernel
stack: runtime/infer -> worker -> kv-cache
```

irene: that smells like quant kernel regression in the new build. Was any quant-lib bumped in this release?

leo: yes — build r-2026-03-15 included lib-mkq v2.4.1 which has the new fused-attn codepath. We tested on large batches but not on the short-seq canary workload.

marta: immediate mitigation options: 1) disable canary traffic (kill switch) 2) scale down canary replicas to 0 (hard rollback) 3) toggle model-variant to previous stable. Prefer option 3 if supported, to avoid customer impact.

raj: can we switch the canary routing to r-2026-03-15-c2 (previous)? If that’s fast, do it.

leo: I can route the canary back to c2. Running the routing switch now: 
```bash
# routing control plane API
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  https://control.redwood.internal/v1/route/switch \
  -d '{"route": "canary-us-west-2", "target_revision": "r-2026-03-15-c2"}'
```

leo: command returned 202, propagation starting.

ops-bot: ROUTE CHANGE: canary-us-west-2 -> r-2026-03-15-c2 requested by leo. Propagation ETA ~45s.

marta: monitoring for error-rate now.

raj: after the switch, error-rate dropped to 1.1% within a minute. Latency returning to baseline. Good signal.

emily: customer-facing impact? Any external errors surfaced to API customers?

raj: short window (~03:12–03:16 UTC) where ~0.8% of total requests saw 5xx; mostly from canary traffic and internal tests. No large customer outages detected in first-pass logs (most prod traffic routed to stable).

irene: we should still abort the rollout and pin to the previous stable until we root-cause the OOMs. I’ll open a rollback and start a postmortem.

leo: initiating rollback of the release to the last known-good (r-2026-03-14). Triggering the abort in release manager: 
```json
POST /api/releases/abort
{ "release_id": "r-2026-03-15", "reason": "canary OOMs with fused-attn lib" }
```

ops-bot: RELEASE ACTION: abort request submitted for r-2026-03-15 by leo.

marta: toggled the canary kill-switch flag to prevent automatic re-rollouts: 
```bash
# feature-flag toggle
ffcli set rollout.enable_r-2026-03-15 false --scope=canary
```

raj: adding immediate next steps for the incident record: 1) abort rollout (done) 2) disable fused-attn in build pipeline 3) replicate failing workload locally and reproduce OOM 4) postmortem within 48h.

emily: I’ll prepare a short customer note saying we aborted a canary rollout due to stability regressions, no sustained customer impact. Draft in #general after we confirm numbers. :thumbsup:

marta: assigning owners: leo owns rollback and pipeline revert, raj+irene to investigate memory regression, emily to draft comms.

raj: handoff — I need to go offline in 40m. If things regress, page oncall primary and tag me as fallback.

irene: I’ll stay with the thread for the next hour and then hand to marta for the night shift.

marta: I’ll take the handoff at 04:00 UTC and run the deeper memory tracing. Leaving notes in the incident ticket: https://incident.redwood/internal/INC-2026-3112

oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: P0 reduced to P1 (canary roll aborted) — mitigation successful. Please continue investigation.

raj: thanks all. Logging the timeline and adding logs + heap dumps to the ticket.

leo: started the pipeline revert PR (link: https://git.internal/redwood/release/PR-4523). Will not re-promote until postmortem and green tests for mem usage.

emily: ETA for customer note? I can post a brief in ~30m after confirm.

marta: confirmed postmortem owners and severity. Closing pager state for now but keeping thread live for follow-ups.

ops-bot: PAGING: next oncall (marta) acknowledged at 04:00 UTC.

raj: last note — if you need the heap dumps: s3://redwood-internal/incident/INC-2026-3112/heapdumps/ . Encrypted with KMS.

irene: thanks team. Handing to marta.

marta: taking over — will update incident ticket with reproduction steps.

oncall-bot: THREAD CLOSED — mitigation applied, rollback complete, investigation in progress.
